title: feat(plugin-grid): Excel parsing, type inference, and paste-to-import for the Import Wizard
body:
## What

Extends the plugin-grid **Import Wizard** beyond CSV with three capabilities:

1. **Excel parsing** — `.xlsx`/`.xlsm` via **ExcelJS**, dynamically imported so it stays out of the main bundle and is lazy-loaded only when an Excel file is dropped.
2. **Column type auto-inference** — detects `number` / `boolean` / `date` / `datetime` and shows an inferred-type badge per column on the Mapping step, plus a warning when a column is mapped to an incompatible field type.
3. **Paste-to-import** — copy a block from Excel / Google Sheets and `Ctrl/⌘+V` inside the wizard; no file needed.

## How

- Parsing + inference extracted into a pure module `importParsers.ts` (`parseSpreadsheetFile`, `parseClipboardTable`, `inferColumnType`, `isTypeCompatible`, …) with unit tests.
- `ImportWizard.tsx` changes are functional only — no layout/styling changes; just the file `accept` list, drag/drop copy, and the type badge + mismatch warning.
- ExcelJS kept **external** in the library build (verified: 0 internal exceljs refs in the main bundle).
- Full **i18n** across all 10 locales (en/zh/ja/ko/de/fr/es/pt/ru/ar).
- Adds a standalone vite demo at `packages/plugin-grid/demo` for manual verification, matching the existing plugin-gantt demo convention.

## Test

- `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: 94 tests pass (incl. 19 new in `importParsers.test.ts`)
- `@object-ui/i18n`: 157 tests pass (locale parity)
- `vite build` clean
- Manually verified end-to-end in the demo: Excel lazy-load, paste TSV, inference badges, type-mismatch warning, full import to a mock dataSource, and localized chrome.
